description: A duration of gaze, a route taken past a desk, a presence in a stockroom. Each is nothing. The pattern is unmistakable and consists entirely of nothings.
energy_note: A pattern made of things that did not happen.

description: Any account sounds paranoid when written down, which the person doing it relies on and may well have tested before.
energy_note: Say it aloud and hear how it sounds.

description: Different route to the printer, never last to leave, cardigan kept on the chair. Unpaid, continuous, and invisible to everyone including the people who would want to help.
energy_note: A set of rules she follows and has never told anyone.

description: He is always already in there. Every time. He is polite, he moves aside, he says something about the weather. On the eleventh occasion she starts going at lunch instead, and nothing has happened, and nothing will.
energy_note: Eleven times, and not one thing to report.
